observed_sentence: Minority current business use and aggregate productivity data leave the breadth of AI's production impact unresolved.

diagnosis.intended_meaning: Fewer than half of measured businesses report current AI use.
diagnosis.failure: Minority was used as a malformed modifier for an abstract measure, leaving the counted population implicit and inviting a demographic interpretation.

correction.rule: Make the counted population the grammatical subject.
preferred_forms: Use fewer than half when the threshold matters.
Use most when a supported above-half distinction matters.

diagnostic_behavior.control: Fewer than half of businesses currently report AI use.
